facts.fact: MTN Nigeria, the listed operator (a subsidiary of the South African MTN Group), more than tripled its capital expenditure to N757.4 billion ($527.08 million) in the first nine months of 2025, as the article reports; no financier other than the company itself is named.
Airtel Nigeria, part of the Indian-headquartered Airtel Africa group, invested $166 million between Q2 and Q4 2025, as the article reports.

Airtel Nigeria announced a further $120 million investment in a 38-megawatt hyperscale data centre at Eko Atlantic, Lagos, scheduled to open in 2026; the year of the announcement is not given, so the 2026-02-17 publication year is used.

note: The $392.91 million nine-month 2025 telecoms FDI total (NBS capital importation) is an aggregate, not a named deal, so no fact.
